    JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
)
SELECT 
    fc.cntrycode,
    COUNT(*) AS numcust,
    SUM(fc.c_acctbal) AS totacctbal
FROM filtered_customers fc
CROSS JOIN avg_balance ab
WHERE fc.c_acctbal > ab.avg_acctbal
  AND fc.c_custkey IN (SELECT c_custkey FROM customers_with_orders)
GROUP BY fc.cntrycode
ORDER BY fc.cntrycode
